title: Spectrum TG480RTTR Rear-Tine Petrol Cultivator - 211cc, 48cm Working Width

One forward, one reverse - easy to manoeuvre out of trouble A two-speed gearbox with a dedicated reverse means you can back the machine out of a corner, a hedge line or a patch of unexpectedly soft ground without lifting 72kg of cultivator by hand.
